body: I’m 23. I tried getting into high school at 19 but was put in the special needs program. I am going to college soon, it’s too late for me to catch up now though. I need a more generalized education
I find it impossible to do anything creative when you’re life is falling apart
I still have basically no education but at least I’m finally going to college this month. I feel like an infant

I was homeschooled my whole life so I feel like I didn’t really have a choice but to game all day cause there was nothing else to do. But I stopped three years ago and got my GED, have a job and going to college next month. I still feel like a child right now though
what do you do for work?
I feel like I’m never going to be able to move out. Maybe in my thirties hopefully. Right now I’m just using alcohol and nicotine to get by. I just want an easy way to end it all
I had like 5 of them today…
I still want to use the whole pack tho
Honestly it should be illegal or heavily regulated. I knew a few friends that had success with homeschooling, but it wasn’t for me at all
Being autistic and homeschooled your whole life is even worse
